title: Unsupported whole-element extent — a short crack in one ceiling corner
why: A single short crack in a ceiling corner, sound finish, smooth plaster, post-2000. The scope must be localised; 'the entire ceiling' and CEIL-MAKE-GOOD would exceed the defect (corrections 1, 2).

room.name: Bedroom 2
room.note: One crack in the ceiling corner above the wardrobe, about 300mm, following the board joint. Smooth plaster, sound elsewhere. Readings normal, 8%.

transcripts: Bedroom two. Single crack in the corner of the ceiling over the wardrobe, three hundred long, runs along the board joint. Rest of the ceiling's fine, smooth plaster. Eight percent, dry.

must_not_happen.label: no whole-element scope for a 300 mm crack

must_not_happen.pattern: entire ceiling|whole ceiling|the ceiling (should|is to) be (replaced|overboarded|re-?skimmed)
must_not_happen.label: no over-reaching works
no asbestos condition on a post-2000 smooth plaster ceiling

allowed_uncertainty: CEIL-CRACK-LOCAL × 1 priced on an assumption is the expected outcome.
reviewer_notes: Asbestos should not be raised: post-2000, smooth plaster — the asbestos rule's era test is satisfied only when pre-2000 is true or unknown.
